# Conclusion {.unnumbered .unlisted} 

## Comparison: VAE vs. Autoencoder vs. GAN 

| Aspect | Autoencoder | VAE | GAN |
|--------|-------------|-----|-----|
| **Latent space** | Irregular, gaps | Continuous, structured | Continuous (implicit) |
| **Loss** | Reconstruction only | Reconstruction + KL | Adversarial |
| **Training** | Stable | Stable | Unstable |
| **Generation quality** | Poor (not generative) | Good | Excellent |
| **Mode coverage** | N/A | Good (covers all modes) | Poor (mode collapse) |
| **Likelihood** | N/A | Computable (lower bound) | Not computable |
| **Latent inference** | Fast (one pass) | Fast (one pass) | Slow (optimization) or N/A |
| **Use cases** | Compression, denoising | Generative modeling, latent space manipulation | High-fidelity synthesis |
